title: quick-collab-availability-and-mini-burn-forecast
content:
Purpose: quick, shared availability tracker + back-of-envelope incremental burn estimate for the ad-hoc feature support window (next 7 days). Use this to surface pinch points, confirm owners for surge tasks, and decide whether to spin up a 24h rotation or accept degraded SLAs.

Working assumptions:
- Surge window: Aug 6 - Aug 12 (7 calendar days) — lightweight feature rollout + fallback testing across regions.
- Hourly fully-loaded cost assumption for incremental contractor/overhire = $120/hr (placeholder).
- Goal: keep total incremental spend < $18k for the week if possible.

Table: columns delimited by | for easy copy/paste into sheets
Owner | Role | Timezone | Avail (hrs next 7d) | Expected support (hrs) | Primary responsibilities | Dependency / blocking tickets | Quick asks (90m max) | Est incremental burn ($)
Maya Patel | Product Ops | PST | 18 | 12 | coordination, runbook edits, point for CS | CON-411, OPS-1123 | confirm runbook changes before 8/6 | 1440
Diego Alvarez | Eng SRE | PDT | 28 | 20 | emergency rollbacks, routing fixes | SRE-987 | hold 2h/day standby for rollouts | 2400
Harper Nguyen | Solutions Eng | CET | 10 | 8 | customer handoffs, escalations | SE-210 | prepare FAQ snippet (30m) | 960
Priya Rao | Observability | IST | 12 | 10 | alert tuning, dashboard updates | OBS-55 | push metrics patch (1h) | 1200
Samir Joshi | Platform Eng | PST | 24 | 16 | capacity gating, burst controls | PLAT-72 | enable burst policy test config | 1920
Alex Martinez | Customer Success (temp) | PDT | 6 | 6 | customer comms, escalations | CS-317 | standby for priority customers | 720
Rina Chen | Dedicated Sales Eng | JST | 8 | 4 | SLA comms for dedicated accounts | SALES-99 | confirm account list (15m) | 480
Total estimated hours | 106 | 76 |  |  |  |  | Total est burn = $9120

Quick notes on table: estimated support hours are conservative; some owners double-up on tasks so account for elbow room. The total incremental burn shown here only reflects headcount hours * $120/hr; infrastructure/instance costs not included.

Short analysis (2-line):
- With current volunteer coverage we hit ~76 support hours; at $120/hr that maps to ~$9.1k incremental headcount spend — comfortably under the $18k soft cap.
- Risk: Diego and Samir concentrated on critical path (routing + capacity). If either drops below 12 hrs, plan for 8-12h contractor backfill (~$960-$1440/day).

Rapid risk radar (one-liners):
- Observability gap: alert dedup rule not yet deployed (OBS-55) — if noisy, adds 6-12 extra hours. Owner: Priya.
- Region parity: EU fallback not smoke-tested against dedicated variants — risks escalations late shift. Owner: Samir/Harper.
- Customer comms: one top-10 account flagged for dedicated SLA review (SALES-99) — may need Samir or Rina 1h deep-dive.

Action items (owner -> action -> target by):
- Maya -> finalize 1-page runbook + escalation matrix -> 2029-08-05 EOD
- Diego -> run pre-rollout routing check and share checklist -> 2029-08-05 AM
- Priya -> deploy alert dedup rules to staging -> 2029-08-05 noon
- Samir -> enable burst policy in eu-test -> 2029-08-05 EOD
- Harper -> draft customer-facing FAQ + release note blurb -> 2029-08-05 PM
- Alex -> prepare hold message templates for CS -> 2029-08-05 AM

Contingency triggers (what to do if triggered):
- If any single critical owner reports >40% reduction in availability -> escalate to Ops Lead (Diego/Maya) and authorize 24h contractor cover at up to $180/hr.
- If mean latency across prod regions spikes +30% for >30min -> pause rollout and revert canary route for 1 hour.

Notes to self / freeform scratch:
- Quick spreadsheet formulas to drop in sheet: total_burn = sum(est incremental burn), cushion = 18000 - total_burn, contractor_need = if(any(owner_gap), ceil(gap_hours/8)*8*120).
- Consider pulling short-term contractor for overnight monitoring rather than daytime coverage; cheaper and still useful for alerts.

Useful links / tickets to check: CON-411 (runbook stub), OPS-1123 (rollout ops checklist), OBS-55 (alert patch), SRE-987 (routing health run), SALES-99 (account list).

Next sync: 15min async summary on 2029-08-05 09:00 PDT in #ops-rollouts. If anything changes — update this sheet and ping Maya.

End of doc.
